model_and_reference.ideal_model: Per ideal independent row: independent standard-normal A,B,Z; S1=A; S2=B; T=(A+B+sigma*Z)/sqrt(2+sigma^2).
model_and_reference.ideal_support: Full-dimensional joint Gaussian for each positive listed sigma; a population-model declaration, not inferred from unique binary64 samples.
model_and_reference.represented_inputs: Deterministic xorshift64*/Box-Muller binary64 realizations; first uniform input is floored at 1e-12. These approximate the ideal Gaussian model.
model_and_reference.cross_sigma_coupling: Every sigma restarts the same seed and reuses identical latent A/B/Z draws; four coupled law settings, not independent replications.
model_and_reference.gauge: Equal standard-normal source marginals in fixed population-standardized coordinates, constant relative precision and common source partition convention; target normalized by its known population scale.
model_and_reference.reference: Analytic Gaussian pointwise MI and density-weighted log-sum-exp integrand, then a Monte Carlo mean on the estimator's same rows; not an exact population value.
model_and_reference.reference_mc_se: Welford sample standard deviation divided by sqrt(N), interpreted only for the reference mean under the ideal independent-row model.
model_and_reference.paired_uncertainty_boundary: kNN local estimate terms share fitted neighbour structure; a naive independent-row MCSE for those terms does not supply paired-discrepancy uncertainty. Independent full-data replications would be a separate study and were not run here.
model_and_reference.decimal_encoding: Strings preserve original four-decimal printed precision; no extra digits or certified error intervals are inferred.
